thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 page — spike: ~23% of /embeddings calls from eu-west returned 4xx/5xx after the 04/12 release. Alert: https://alerts.internal/alert/9842

sara_oncall: Acknowledged. TL;DR impact? who is affected?

liz_support: Two enterprise customers reported search failing (CS-1127, CS-1130). Support spike started ~4076543180. We're routing them to oncall for comms.

corey_sre: Quick dump of routing table shows alias `embeddings-prod` now points to `chat-instruct-v2@2026-04-12` (interface: chat). That's wrong — should be `embeddings-encoder-v1`. Looks like an anchor from the last release switched the alias.

emma_ml: Confirming: chat variants don't expose the embed endpoints; requests are being coerced into generation path and failing validation -> 400s and 500s for some client payloads.

corey_sre: Snippet from routing state:```json
{
  "alias": "embeddings-prod",
  "bound_variant": "chat-instruct-v2@2026-04-12",
  "interface": "chat"
}
```

corey_sre: Proposed mitigation: rebind alias to the previous embeddings variant and hold the release anchor. Quick command (admin API):```bash
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/v1/aliases/embeddings-prod/rebind" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"variant": "embeddings-encoder-v1@2026-03-30"}'
```

sara_oncall: Do it. Also scale the embeddings pool +1 while we verify. Notify affected customers with note that a routing regression caused failures; ETA ~10m.

corey_sre: Running rebind now...

corey_sre: Response: `200 OK` -> alias now bound to `embeddings-encoder-v1@2026-03-30`. Verified traffic shift via metrics: error rate for embeddings in eu-west dropped from 23% -> 0.6% within 45s. :white_check_mark:

liz_support: Customer notif drafted, sending now. Will attach incident link and ETA for postmortem.

incident-bot: Severity changed: P0 -> mitigated. Incident page: https://incidents.internal/4076543210 (created).

raj_prod: Root cause: in the release manifest the `anchor.interface` field was not populated; CI defaulted ambiguous anchors to `chat` for that service. The release job then anchored the alias to a chat variant.

corey_sre: Manifest excerpt:```yaml
release:
  id: 2026-04-12
  anchors:
    - name: embeddings-prod-anchor
      variant: chat-instruct-v2@2026-04-12   # <-- wrong
      # missing: interface: embeddings
```

mike_infra: Action items: 1) Add CI validation to ensure anchor.variant interface matches alias intent (owner: eng-release, due: 2026-04-20). 2) Add a preflight check that rejects releasing anchors to aliases in prod without explicit interface tag (owner: eng-sre, due: 2026-04-18). 3) Add an automated rollback playbook for alias rebinds (owner: platform-runbooks).

emma_ml: Also recommend a compatibility gate: when binding an alias, verify the model advertises the required interface (embed/gen/chat) and run a lightweight probe that hits the expected endpoint before committing the bind.

sara_oncall: Good. I'll schedule a follow-up postmortem and include customers + CS + release owners. For now incident is mitigated. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

corey_sre: Filing postmortem draft, linking logs and the rebind command output.

liz_support: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and confirm CS tickets closed once we've published the postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident closed for active mitigation. Please update incident page with RCA and action owners when available.
